subject: [PATCH 02/12] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch series refactors the khugepaged code to improve its functionality and efficiency. Specifically, it addresses a bug where the khugepaged_pages_collapsed counter was being incremented incorrectly when khugepaged collapses pages. The patch introduces changes to the collapse_single_pmd function to fix this issue.
